articles.summary: Toast (NYSE: TOST), the global technology platform built for restaurant and retail businesses, today announced that management will present at the UBS Global Technology and AI Conference in Scottsdale, AZ on Wednesday, December 2, 2026 at 8:55 a.m. MST. A webcast of the company presentation will be available on Toast's Investor Relations website at https://investors.toasttab.com/overview/ . About Toast Toast [NYSE: TOST] is a global technology platform built for restaurant and retail businesses. From the busiest local restaurants and shops to large hospitality brands, Toast helps owners and operators manage their businesses more efficiently, drive guest demand, and build lasting success. Toast integrates software, agentic AI, payments, financial technology solutions, and hardware with a broad partner ecosystem. articles.summary: Toast (NYSE:TOST), the global technology platform built for restaurant and retail businesses, today announced an agreement with Great Harvest to implement Toast Enterprise Solutions. articles.summary: Toast (NYSE:TOST), the global technology platform built for restaurant and retail businesses, today announced an agreement with Ruby Tuesday , a leading casual American bar and grill chain, to implement Toast enterprise technology across Ruby Tuesday restaurants systemwide. Ruby Tuesday selected Toast because of its ability to help them evolve the technology experience for their employees and guests. It will leverage Toast Go® 3 handhelds, Toast Flex 3 terminals , and Toast Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), in addition to Toast Payment Processing to help them deliver the outstanding service and uncompromising quality that defines their hospitality. articles.title: Ruby Tuesday Selects Toast to Drive Its Next Chapter
